post.description: Deliveries follow Standard Webhooks: POST with `webhook-id` (the event id), `webhook-timestamp` and `webhook-signature` (`v1,<base64 HMAC-SHA256>`) headers and a canonical JSON body `{id, type, timestamp, data}`. Delivery is at-least-once: receivers must verify the signature and deduplicate on `webhook-id`. Non-2xx responses and timeouts (10 s) are retried with exponential backoff, at most 5 times. The URL must be https:// and resolve to public addresses only (422 UNSAFE_WEBHOOK_URL); at most 20 active endpoints per institution.

info.title: 10mg Lending Core API
info.description: Multi-tenant, white-label lending API. Tenant context comes from the access token; money amounts are integer strings in ISO-4217 minor units; errors are RFC 9457 problem details; money-moving POSTs require an Idempotency-Key header.

homeRegion.description: AWS region of the home cell

apiBaseUrl.description: Base URL to send this institution’s API requests to

accessToken.description: JWT access token (HS256), sent as `Authorization: Bearer`

refreshToken.description: Opaque refresh token; single use, rotated on every refresh
Refresh token from the previous sign-in or refresh

password.description: At least 12 characters including upper case, lower case and a digit

maxAprBps.description: Usury cap on the all-in APR, basis points

homeRegion.description: AWS region that holds this tenant’s data (cell-based residency, SPEC §4.1)

maxAprBps.description: Regulatory APR ceiling in basis points; null = none

version.description: Send back as expectedVersion on PUT

locale.description: BCP 47 tag: en-NG, fr-SN, en-GB, fr-FR, …

logoObjectKey.description: Key returned by POST /v1/institution/branding/logo-upload-url after the upload succeeded. Must belong to the caller’s tenant. Null removes the logo.

contentType.description: SVG is not accepted (it can carry script — stored XSS risk)

fields.description: Form fields to send verbatim, before the `file` field

password.description: At least 12 characters including upper case, lower case and a digit

permissions.description: Permissions the role holds (drives which actions a client offers)

nationalId.description: BVN or NIN (11 digits). Stored only as an HMAC plus the last 4 digits.

currency.description: Must be supported by the institution

password.description: At least 12 characters including upper case, lower case and a digit

value.description: FLAT: minor units; PERCENTAGE: bps; NONE: 0

currency.description: Must be offered by the institution

expectedVersion.description: The product’s current version as read (optimistic check)

disbursementDate.description: Defaults to today in the institution’s time zone

type.description: Defaults to the product’s disbursement mode

account.description: Bank account / wallet of the payee

customerId.description: Required for staff applying on a customer’s behalf; customers apply for self

term.description: Instalments, or days for a BULLET product

payee.description: Required for BORROWER-mode products (a customer may only name a BORROWER payee). For VENDOR-mode (checkout) products the payee is the checkout order’s vendor as resolved by the procurement platform; if sent, it must be that vendor’s account (422 PAYEE_NOT_ALLOWED).

externalOrderReference.description: Checkout order id; required for VENDOR-mode products (422 CHECKOUT_ORDER_NOT_FOUND when the procurement platform does not know it)

approvedPrincipal.description: Defaults to the request (or the counter-offer amount)

preview.description: True before disbursement (priced as if disbursed today)

total.description: Pay exactly this to settle and close the loan

externalReference.description: Provider / bank statement reference, unique per institution (409 DUPLICATE). Required for every channel except CASH (422 EXTERNAL_REFERENCE_REQUIRED)

valueDate.description: Date the money was received; defaults to business today. Must be on or after the disbursement date and the latest recorded repayment’s value date, at most REPAYMENT_MAX_BACKDATE_DAYS (default 3) before today, never in the future (422 VALUE_DATE_OUT_OF_RANGE)

settled.description: The payment settled and closed the loan

asOf.description: Business date to close (not in the future)

loansSkipped.description: Busy loans left for the next run

firstBrokenEntryId.description: Id of the first entry whose hash does not verify

url.description: https:// only. The host must resolve to public addresses only (SSRF guard); it is re-checked at every delivery.

secret.description: Standard Webhooks signing secret. Returned ONLY in this response: store it now. Verify deliveries with a Standard Webhooks library and deduplicate on `webhook-id`.
